title: Scalable long-range machine learning interatomic potentials with electrical response for atomistic material modeling
title_zh: 可扩展的远程机器学习原子间势与原子材料建模的电响应
summary: 在电场下对材料进行精确的原子模拟需要在长度尺度上进行长程静电和电响应建模，这超出了传统第一原理方法的范围。然而，这些功能仍然难以与机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的可扩展性相协调。严格的局部模型可以实现高效的空间并行化，但忽略了远程交互，而现有的静电扩展引入了阻碍分布式计算的全局依赖性。在这里，我们通过分析将长程静电力和玻恩有效电荷（BEC）分离为全局静电计算和学习潜电荷的严格局部导数来克服这一限制。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate atomistic simulations of materials under electric fields require long-range electrostatics and electrical-response modeling at length scales beyond the reach of conventional first-principles methods. Yet these capabilities remain difficult to reconcile with the scalability of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Strictly local models enable efficient spatial parallelization but neglect long-range interactions, whereas existing electrostatic extensions introduce global dependencies that hinder distributed computation. Here, we overcome this limitation by analytically separating the long-range electrostatic forces and Born effective charges (BECs) into a global electrostatics calculation and strictly local derivatives of learned latent charges. This formulation preserves the spatial decomposability of equivariant MLIPs while enabling distributed evaluation of energies, forces, stresses, and BECs across different boundary conditions. Implemented as DPA4C-LR on the textttnvalchemi platform, the framework scales to 5.2 million atoms on four GPUs at approximately twice the computational cost of its short-range backbone. Trained on energies and forces, DPA4C-LR accurately infers BECs and reproduces the field-dependent infrared spectra of water. We further demonstrate its capabilities by recovering the characteristic slim polarization hysteresis of relaxor cePb(Mg₁/₃Nb₂/₃)O3, which is obscured by finite-size effects in smaller simulations; predicting a room-temperature field-driven ionic conductivity of 6.8 ± 0.7~mS/cm in amorphous ceLi₀.₉NbO₀.₉Cl₄.₁; and modeling interfacial thermal transport across Si/diamond interfaces with slab-corrected electrostatics. By combining long-range physics, electrical-response inference, and distributed computation, this framework extends predictive atomistic modeling toward device-relevant length scales.

title: Training Dataset Matters for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: Water Simulation as an Example
title_zh: 训练数据集对于机器学习原子间势很重要：以水模拟为例
summary: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 的准确预测依赖于涵盖相关热力学条件和相的训练数据集。以水为例，我们表明，MLIP 采样数据集不充分会导致对密度、熔化温度和核量子效应的错误预测。相比之下，使用相同电子结构方法在综合数据集上训练的 MLIP 可以产生与 MLIP 架构无关的一致属性预测，其密度与参考计算在定量上一致。
abstract: arXiv:2512.23939v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate predictions of machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) rely on training datasets covering relevant thermodynamic conditions and phases. Using water as an example, we show that insufficiently sampled datasets of MLIPs lead to wrong predictions of densities, melting temperatures, and nuclear quantum effects. In contrast, MLIPs trained on comprehensive datasets with the same electronic structure method yield consistent property predictions agnostic of MLIP architecture, with densities in quantitative agreement with reference calculations.

title: Linear response for machine-learned interatomic potentials: phonons at arbitrary wave vectors from the primitive cell
title_zh: 机器学习原子间势的线性响应：来自原始细胞的任意波矢量的声子
summary: 使用机器学习的原子间势的声子计算几乎完全是在超级单元中的有限位移下进行的，这种方法仅在与超级单元相称的波矢量上才准确，其误差取决于力常数的范围。在消息传递网络中，这个范围随着层数的增加而增长，对于最深的通用模型来说达到 140 埃。在这里，我们证明，本着密度泛函微扰理论的精神，可以在任何波矢量下在原胞中精确地获得消息传递势的动态矩阵，作为力对布洛赫相位调制的位移的线性响应。仅当相邻原子的特征聚集时才进入该阶段，并且训练后的模型无需修改即可使用。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23545v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon calculations with machine-learned interatomic potentials are almost exclusively performed with finite displacements in supercells, an approach that is exact only at wave vectors commensurate with the supercell and whose error depends on the range of the force constants. In message-passing networks this range grows with the number of layers, and reaches 140 angstrom for the deepest universal models. Here we show that the dynamical matrix of a message-passing potential can be obtained exactly in the primitive cell, at any wave vector, as the linear response of the forces to a displacement modulated by a Bloch phase, in the spirit of density-functional perturbation theory. The phase enters only where the features of neighboring atoms are gathered, and the trained model is used without modification. One further derivative yields group velocities and mode Grüneisen parameters analytically. We apply the method to NequIP and Prophet, and reproduce the Hessians of supercells to machine precision. Using these results as a reference, we find that the supercells commonly employed in high-throughput calculations lead to errors of several tenths of a THz in the phonon frequencies, and that these errors decrease slowly with the size of the supercell, in particular for deep models. For a low-symmetry silicate, the supercell predicts a dynamical instability that the model does not have. Quantities that depend on derivatives of the dispersion, such as the group velocities and the Grüneisen parameter at low temperature, are considerably more affected than the frequencies themselves. When both approaches are used to obtain the same force constants, their computational cost is comparable for crystals with symmetry.

title: From Surface Reactions to Inhibitor Coverage: A Machine-Learning-Assisted Computational Study of Area-Selective Atomic Layer Deposition
title_zh: 从表面反应到抑制剂覆盖：区域选择性原子层沉积的机器学习辅助计算研究
summary: 区域选择性原子层沉积 (AS-ALD) 能够实现选择性材料生长，用于制造纳米级半导体器件。预测抑制剂覆盖率对于理解和优化 AS-ALD 中的表面封闭至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种计算工作流程，将预训练的通用机器学习原子间势与晶格外正则蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，并将其应用于非晶 SiO2 上的抑制剂吸附和前体阻断。真实的表面模型揭示了反应能量和活化势垒的显着位点依赖性变化，其中硅烷醇基团充当氨基硅烷和相关抑制剂和金属前体的主要吸附位点。
abstract: arXiv:2610.22911v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Area-selective atomic layer deposition (AS-ALD) enables selective material growth for the fabrication of nanoscale semiconductor devices. Predicting inhibitor coverage is essential for understanding and optimizing surface blocking in AS-ALD. Here, we present a computational workflow combining a pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potential with off-lattice grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations and apply it to inhibitor adsorption and precursor blocking on amorphous SiO2. Realistic surface models reveal substantial site-dependent variations in reaction energies and activation barriers, with silanol groups serving as the primary adsorption sites for aminosilane and related inhibitors and metal precursors. Coverage simulations show that inhibitors producing identical adsorbed fragments can yield different coverages because the intact molecules impose distinct steric constraints, leading to different accessible site densities and blocking capabilities. Beyond coverage, we highlight the importance of the reactivity of adsorbed inhibitor fragments toward precursors in determining inhibitor stability and blocking performance. Together, these findings demonstrate the need to consider both steric effects and chemical reactivity on realistic amorphous surfaces. Our calculations connect local reaction chemistry with inhibitor coverage and provide a computational basis for understanding inhibition mechanisms and selecting suitable inhibitor-precursor combinations for AS-ALD.

title: Microscopic origin of polytype-dependent melting in SiC revealed by machine-learning molecular dynamics
title_zh: 机器学习分子动力学揭示 SiC 中多型依赖熔化的微观起源
summary: 预测晶体结构如何影响高温稳定性仍然是材料建模和设计中的一个关键挑战。碳化硅 (SiC) 是已知的热稳定性和化学稳定性最高的材料之一，为研究这一问题提供了理想的系统，因为它的许多多型体保留了相似的局部四面体键合，但长程堆叠几何形状不同。为了确定多型结构对 SiC 高温稳定性的影响，我们将相共存机器学习分子动力学与有限温度声子分析相结合，通过微调的 MACE 原子间势来实现，该势能准确描述多种 SiC 多型的晶体、高温和无序构型。
abstract: Predicting how crystal structure influences high-temperature stability remains a key challenge in materials modeling and design. Silicon carbide (SiC), one of the most thermally and chemically stable materials known, provides an ideal system for studying this problem because its many polytypes preserve similar local tetrahedral bonding while differing in long-range stacking geometry. To determine the impact of polytype structure on the high-temperature stability of SiC, we combine phase-coexistence machine-learning molecular dynamics with finite-temperature phonon analysis, enabled by a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential that accurately describes crystalline, high-temperature, and disordered configurations across multiple SiC polytypes. We identify a clear stability ordering, 3C > 2H > 9R, reflected consistently in structural disordering, interlayer sliding, and finite-temperature phonon spectra. Across all polytypes, melting initiates through the formation of short C–C contacts and carbon-rich local regions, followed by a progressive loss of tetrahedral Si–C connectivity. The reduced stability of the long-period 9R polytype is associated with a denser manifold of low-frequency transverse-acoustic modes arising from its stacking periodicity and associated zone folding, which broaden and soften further at high temperature. These modes can provide additional low-energy channels for thermally activated lateral bilayer motion, consistent with the larger sliding amplitudes observed in 9R and their positive correlation with local structural disorder.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Response Tensors in Crystalline Magnets: Application to Kagome Metals
title_zh: 晶体磁体响应张量的物理信息机器学习：在 Kagome 金属中的应用
summary: 从磁性纹理预测响应张量是非共线磁体研究中的一个关键挑战。用于构造给定响应张量的描述符的现有方法仅限于一阶多极展开或仅限于简单的磁结构。在这项工作中，我们为任意晶体结构和磁性纹理构建了完整的对称不变描述符基础，为响应张量的机器学习建模提供了可解释的特征。我们修改标准主成分分析框架并导出层次稳定的不相关阶次参数：扩展阶次参数空间以包含更高阶的自旋阶次引入与先前的阶次参数不相关的额外阶次参数。我们将该框架应用于磁 kagome 晶格中反常霍尔电导率 (AHC) 的回归和分类。
abstract: arXiv:2610.22642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The prediction of response tensors from magnetic textures is a crucial challenge in the study of noncollinear magnets. Existing methods for constructing descriptors of a given response tensor are limited to first-order multipole expansions or restricted to simple magnetic structures. In this work, we construct a complete symmetry-invariant descriptor basis for arbitrary crystal structures and magnetic textures, providing interpretable features for machine learning modeling of response tensors. We modify the standard principal component analysis framework and derive uncorrelated order parameters that are hierarchically stable: extending the order parameter space to include higher-degree spin order introduces additional order parameters that are uncorrelated to the previous ones. We apply this framework to regression and classification of the anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in a magnetic kagome lattice. In particular, in the regime where AHC is well modeled by linear regression of the symmetry-invariant order parameters, we find that the squared regression coefficients, ranked by their magnitude, obey a Zipf-like power law: βᵣ² propto r⁻α. Our method provides a systematic route to construct interpretable order parameters of all spin orders that connect the symmetry of a magnetic crystal to its response tensors.

title: Electrified Metal-Water Interfaces at Constant Potential: Data-Efficient Transfer Learning for Machine-Learning-Based Molecular Dynamics
title_zh: 恒定电势的带电金属-水界面：基于机器学习的分子动力学的数据高效迁移学习
summary: 在恒定电势下用显式溶剂模拟带电金属-水界面对于理解电化学过程至关重要，但从头计算方法仍然非常昂贵。我们推出了 TRECI，这是一种数据高效的工作流程，用于构建机器学习力场 (ML-FF)，可在电子大规范分子动力学中实现从头开始的精度。通过利用通用和特定领域模型的迁移学习，TRECI 使用更少的参考配置在广泛的潜在范围内实现稳定和准确的模拟。这种效率允许使用高级元 GGA 函数和严格的表面电气化方案。
abstract: arXiv:2511.19338v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Simulating electrified metal-water interfaces with explicit solvent under constant potential is essential for understanding electrochemical processes, yet remains prohibitively expensive with ab initio methods. We present TRECI, a data-efficient workflow for constructing machine learning force-fields (ML-FFs) that achieve ab initio-level accuracy in electronically grand-canonical molecular dynamics. By leveraging transfer learning from general-purpose and domain-specific models, TRECI enables stable and accurate simulations across a wide potential range using a reduced number of reference configurations. This efficiency allows the use of high-level meta-GGA functionals and rigorous surface-electrification schemes. Applied to Cu(111)-water, models trained on just one thousand configurations yield accurate molecular dynamics simulations, capturing bias-dependent solvent restructuring effects not previously reported. TRECI offers a general strategy for characterising diverse materials and interfacial chemistries, significantly lowering the cost of realistic constant-potential simulations and expanding access to quantitative electrochemical modelling.

title: Reconstruction of Magnetic Fields with a Physics-Informed Neural Network
title_zh: 使用物理信息神经网络重建磁场
summary: 磁场及其梯度的准确重建对于评估和控制精密测量实验中的系统效应至关重要。我们开发了一种基于物理的神经网络 (PINN) 方法，该方法根据无源麦克斯韦方程组 nablacdotB=0 和 nablatimesB=0 重建三维磁场。在我们之前关于 PINN 方法通过外部位置测量重建难以到达的内部区域磁场的工作的扩展中，我们现在证明了应用 PINN 方法从受麦克斯韦方程组约束的离散测量点提取磁场梯度项的可行性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate reconstruction of magnetic fields and their gradients is essential for assessing and controlling systematic effects in precision measurement experiments. We have developed a physics-informed neural network (PINN) method which reconstructs three-dimensional magnetic fields subject to the source-free Maxwell equations, nablacdotB=0 and nablatimesB=0. In an extension of our previous work on PINN methods for reconstruction of magnetic fields in inaccessible interior regions via measurements at exterior locations, we now demonstrate the feasibility of applying PINN methods to the extraction of magnetic field gradient terms from discrete measurement points subject to constraints from Maxwell's equations.

title: Machine-learning disordered Hubbard model underlying semiconductor quantum dot based two-dimensional spin qubit arrays
title_zh: 基于半导体量子点的二维自旋量子位阵列的机器学习无序哈伯德模型
summary: 作者：Jacob R. Taylor 和 Sankar Das Sarma 我们理论上开发了一种基于机器学习的方法，使用基于张量网络生成的电荷稳定性数据训练的基于视觉的神经网络，推断自旋量子位平台下的无序二维 (2D) 广义哈伯德模型中的随机现场能量波动。我们……[物理。 Rev. B 114, 245124] 2026 年 10 月 19 日星期一发布
abstract: Author(s): Jacob R. Taylor and Sankar Das Sarma We theoretically develop a machine-learning-based method for inferring the random onsite-energy fluctuations in disordered two-dimensional (2D) generalized Hubbard models underlying spin-qubit platforms, using vision-based neural networks trained on tensor-network-generated charge-stability data. We… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 245124] Published Mon Oct 19, 2026

title: Learning the self-energy through equivariant neural networks
title_zh: 通过等变神经网络学习自能量
summary: 电子自能决定了单粒子格林函数，并通过它决定了准粒子能量和谱函数，但从第一原理计算它的成本很高，而且它是一个困难的机器学习目标：复值、局部轨道基础上的矩阵值，并且依赖于连续频率。我们预测了来自原子种类的分子的虚频 G₀W₀ 自能矩阵的动态相关部分，并与 E(3) 等变消息传递网络进行协调，轨道空间矩阵的旋转协方差由结构本身施加，静态交换部分取自密度泛函参考。频率作为显式网络输入或通过特定于频率的输出头进入，并且预测矩阵以因果关系和非负谱密度通过构造保持的表示延续至实轴。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic self-energy determines the single-particle Green's function and, through it, quasiparticle energies and spectral functions, but computing it from first principles is expensive and it is a difficult machine-learning target: complex-valued, matrix-valued in a local-orbital basis, and dependent on a continuous frequency. We predict the dynamical correlation part of the imaginary-frequency G₀W₀ self-energy matrix of molecules from atomic species and coordinates with an E(3)-equivariant message-passing network, the rotational covariance of the orbital-space matrix being imposed by the architecture itself and the static exchange part taken from the density-functional reference. Frequency enters either as an explicit network input or through frequency-specific output heads, and the predicted matrices are continued to the real axis in a representation in which causality and a non-negative spectral density hold by construction. The frequency-conditioned model reproduces matrix elements to below 1 meV on the imaginary axis for the systems studied here, and that accuracy survives the continuation: for water clusters, including a tetramer absent from the training set, and for chemically diverse molecules from QM9, the reconstructed spectral functions follow the G₀W₀ reference peak by peak and the frontier quasiparticle levels are recovered to a few tens of meV. Learning the self-energy on the imaginary axis is therefore a practical route to real-frequency spectra: once the model is trained, and given the density-functional reference it is built on, a new geometry costs no explicit G₀W₀ calculation.

title: Multitask learning with semiempirical orbital charges enables sample-efficient MLIPs
title_zh: 具有半经验轨道电荷的多任务学习可实现样本高效的 MLIP
summary: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 需要生成计算成本高昂的大规模训练数据集，以准确模拟材料和分子。使用多任务学习结合电子结构信息可以提高样本效率，但是，对于大型数据集来说，对随原子数量呈二次方缩放的完整哈密顿矩阵进行训练是很困难的。在这项工作中，我们表明，利用轨道解析的半经验电荷进行多任务学习可显着提高 MLIP 中的样本效率和准确性。为了有效地预测轨道电荷，我们实施了专门的等变模型，与不变基线相比，减少了电荷预测误差。
abstract: arXiv:2605.24073v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) require generating computationally expensive, large-scale training datasets to accurately simulate materials and molecules. Incorporating electronic structure information using multitask learning improves sample efficiency, however, training on full Hamiltonian matrices, which scale quadratically with the number of atoms, is intractable for large datasets. In this work, we show that multitask learning utilizing orbitally resolved semiempirical charges significantly improves sample efficiency and accuracy in MLIPs. To efficiently predict orbital charges, we implement a specialized equivariant model, reducing charge prediction error compared to an invariant baseline. By augmenting training with computationally inexpensive GFN1-xTB orbital charges, which scale linearly with the number of atoms, our model achieves a 58% reduction in energy mean absolute error relative to energy-only baselines, and requires five times less data to match their performance. Against the stronger baseline of joint energy-and-force training, orbital charges still reduce the energy error by 12%. Furthermore, our approach matches or outperforms models trained on expensive density functional theory (DFT) atomic charges, capturing orbitally resolved electronic complexity and forcing the network to learn a physically accurate latent space that spontaneously clusters metals by shared chemical properties. Because orbital charges are only required during training, this approach preserves inference efficiency, providing a scalable recipe for developing accurate, data-efficient foundation models for complex chemical systems.

title: Spatial statistics for screening molecular structures
title_zh: 用于筛选分子结构的空间统计
summary: 计算材料发现的主导范式依赖于高度参数化的深度架构，包括消息传递图网络和等变量模型，这些架构需要数百万个DFT标记的训练结构，并产生非凸潜在表示，从而使逆向设计的连续优化复杂化。这些架构在数据稀缺的情况下是不切实际的，这是分子筛选的典型情况，并且在捕获化学无序配置和手性几何形状方面表现出有据可查的局限性。本综述将基于空间统计的特征工程作为一种物理严谨且可立即部署的替代方案。
abstract: arXiv:2605.17147v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The dominant paradigm in computational materials discovery relies on heavily parameterized deep architectures, including message-passing graph networks and equivariant models, that require millions of DFT-labeled training structures and produce non-convex latent representations that complicate continuous optimization for inverse design. These architectures are impractical in data-scarce regimes, which is the typical case in molecular screening, and exhibit well-documented limitations in capturing chemically disordered configurations and chiral geometries. This review presents feature engineering based on spatial statistics as a physically rigorous and immediately deployable alternative. Molecular structures are encoded as voxelized scalar fields, and two-point auto- and cross-correlations are evaluated deterministically via Fast Fourier Transforms, explicitly transferring the burden of spatial pattern recognition from the learning algorithm to a closed-form, physics-informed operation. Principal component analysis of the resulting correlation maps yields low-dimensional, strictly convex representations that support lean neural networks (<100k trainable parameters) and non-parametric surrogate models, achieving sub-2% prediction error with as few as 10 training samples. Demonstrated across periodic crystals, chemically disordered high-entropy alloys, and non-periodic organic molecules, this framework enables Bayesian active learning and zero-shot extrapolation on commodity hardware, which current large-scale architectures cannot replicate at equivalent data budgets.

title: From Atomistic Impurity Landscapes to Two-Level-System Distributions and Microwave Loss: Hydrogen-Induced Losses in Nb₂O₅₋δ and Ta₂O₅₋δ
title_zh: 从原子杂质景观到两能级系统分布和微波损耗：Nb2O5₋δ 和 Ta2O5₋δ 中氢引起的损耗
summary: 我们引入了一个第一原理指导框架，用于预测无序材料中移动杂质的统计TLS分布。通过DFT和最小作用路径验证，机器学习的原子间电位将杂质景观连接到隧道分裂和不对称分布、TLS密度和介电损耗。该框架适用于非晶态Nb ₂ O恤δ和Ta ₂ O恤δ ，暗示间隙氢是微波损耗的来源。在推断的H浓度下，损耗切线与Nb-五氧化二氮测量值相匹配，而Ta中较弱的H吸收再现了Nb/Ta TLS对比度。
abstract: arXiv:2603.17194v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a first-principles-guided framework for predicting statistical TLS distributions from mobile impurities in disordered materials. Machine-learned interatomic potentials, with DFT and minimum-action-path validation, connect impurity landscapes to tunnel-splitting and asymmetry distributions, TLS densities, and dielectric loss. Applied to amorphous Nb₂O₅₋δ and Ta₂O₅₋δ, the framework implicates interstitial hydrogen as a source of microwave loss. Loss tangents match Nb-pentoxide measurements at inferred H concentrations, while weaker H uptake in Ta reproduces the Nb/Ta TLS contrast.

title: Thermal Conductivity and Temperature-Induced Band Gap Renormalization in Crystalline and Amorphous Ga₂O₃
title_zh: 晶体和非晶 Ga2O3 的热导率和温度引起的带隙重正化
summary: 本文通过将机器学习的原子间势（即矩张量势（MTP）模型）与第一性原理计算相结合来确定晶体和非晶氧化镓中的晶格热导率（LTC）和电子-声子相互作用。晶体 β-Ga2O3 在 700 K 时表现出 sim0.45 eV 的显着带隙重整化 (BGR)，其中 sim0.2 eV 是由零点 BGR 引起的。计算得出的β-Ga2O₃经典核运动引起的BGR对温度的依赖性强于非晶Ga2O₃，在900 K时BGR差异达到sim0.18 eV。
abstract: arXiv:2603.29484v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The lattice thermal conductivity (LTC) and electron-phonon interactions in crystalline and amorphous gallium oxide are herein determined by coupling a machine-learned interatomic potential, namely the moment tensor potential (MTP) model, to first-principles calculations. Crystalline β-Ga₂O₃ exhibits a substantial band gap renormalization (BGR) of sim0.45 eV at 700 K, with sim0.2 eV caused by zero-point BGR. The computed temperature dependence of BGR induced by classical nuclear motion in β-Ga₂O₃ is stronger than that in amorphous Ga₂O₃, with the difference in BGR reaching sim0.18 eV at 900 K. Thermal transport calculations reveal that the LTC of amorphous Ga₂O₃ remains near 0.9 W· m⁻¹·K⁻¹ for temperatures between 300 K and 700 K, which is approximately an order of magnitude lower than that of crystalline β-Ga₂O₃. Overall, the presented framework provides a computationally tractable and reliable route for predicting properties of semiconductors (both crystalline and amorphous) under operating conditions relevant to microelectronics and optoelectronics.

title: The effect of oxygen on the surface tension of AlTi metallic alloys
title_zh: 氧对AlTi金属合金表面张力的影响
summary: 我们对 AlTi 金属合金熔体进行分子动力学 (MD) 模拟，特别关注表面特性和氧的影响。模拟使用机器学习的相互作用势（MLIP），最近通过实验数据测试了大块 AlTi 熔体的静态和动态特性 [Kato 等人，2017]。 （2026）]。我们发现，表面张力对氧的响应很大程度上取决于 AlTi 的成分。元素分辨密度分布表明，界面附近的氧富集伴随着无氧液体中观察到的铝表面偏析的抑制。将结果与在微重力下使用悬浮技术获得的实验值进行比较。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of AlTi metallic alloy melts, with a specific focus on surface properties and the effect of oxygen. The simulations use a machine-learned inter- action potential (MLIP) that has recently been tested through experimental data for the statical and dynamical properties of AlTi melts in the bulk [Kato et al. (2026)]. We find that the surface- tension response to oxygen depends strongly on the AlTi composition. Element-resolved density profiles show that oxygen enrichment near the interface is accompanied by a suppression of the Al surface segregation observed in the oxygen-free liquid. The results are compared to experimental values obtained using levitation techniques in microgravity.

title: ADT: All-Atom Diffusion Tokenizer for 3D Molecular Structures
title_zh: ADT：3D 分子结构的全原子扩散分词器
summary: 离散结构标记化为自回归 3D 分子生成提供了一条有前途的途径。然而，现有的标记器面临紧凑表示和全原子重建之间的权衡：原子级标记保留原子细节但产生长序列，而紧凑残基级蛋白质标记通常省略侧链几何结构。为了克服这个限制，我们提出了全原子扩散标记器（ADT），它将标记粒度与重建分辨率解耦。 ADT 对小分子的每个原子使用一个结构标记，对每个蛋白质残基使用一个标记，共同代表主链和侧链几何结构。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discrete structural tokenization provides a promising route to autoregressive 3D molecular generation. Yet, existing tokenizers face a trade-off between compact representation and all-atom reconstruction: atom-level tokens preserve atomic details but produce long sequences, while compact residue-level protein tokens typically omit side-chain geometry. To overcome this limitation, we propose All-atom Diffusion Tokenizer (ADT), which decouples token granularity from reconstruction resolution. ADT uses one structural token per atom for small molecules and one token per protein residue that jointly represents backbone and side-chain geometry. To mitigate geometric distortion introduced by quantization, we leverage the generative capacity of diffusion models to recover fine-grained atomic geometry beyond deterministic decoding from discrete tokens. Extensive experiments across small molecules and proteins demonstrate that ADT achieves strong reconstruction from compact discrete representations while enabling high-quality autoregressive generation of both small molecules and all-atom protein structures. These results establish compact structural tokens as an effective discrete interface for all-atom molecular reconstruction and generation.

title: Angular compliance, not amplitude, governs the dielectric response of BaTiO3
title_zh: 角度顺应性，而不是振幅，决定了BaTiO3的介电响应
summary: 软模式理论指定了频率，而不是局部极性单元的作用。因此， BaTiO3的介电响应背后的真实空间运动仍不清楚。使用电场诱导的分子动力学和机器学习力场，我们表明介电常数跟踪局部Ti-O偏心场诱导的角再分布，而不是其大小。温度和双轴应变通过不同的微观路径改变局部结构，但两种介电响应都坍缩成具有相同方向描述符的共同关系，为软模式行为提供了真实空间对应物。
abstract: arXiv:2609.07219v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Soft-mode theory specifies a frequency, not what a local polar unit does. What real-space motion underlies the dielectric response of BaTiO3 therefore remains unclear. Using electric-field-induced molecular dynamics with a machine-learning force field, we show that the permittivity tracks the field-induced angular redistribution of local Ti-O off-centering, not its magnitude. Temperature and biaxial strain modify the local structure through different microscopic routes, yet both dielectric responses collapse onto a common relation with the same orientational descriptor, providing a real-space counterpart to soft-mode behavior.

title: A Topological Signature of Learning under Noisy Labels
title_zh: 噪声标签下学习的拓扑签名
summary: 噪声监督如何改变神经网络学习的表示？训练精度衡量与训练标签的一致性，但提供的有关表示几何的信息很少。我们使用持久同源性来跟踪神经激活中跨距离阈值的循环结构。实验涵盖图像分类、文本分类和模运算。在固定的 CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 训练探针上，大小相同的干净标签和损坏标签子集在第 10 轮时没有显示出可检测到的持久性差异，而损坏标签子集在第 50 轮时具有更高的持久性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How does noisy supervision change the representations learned by a neural network? Training accuracy measures agreement with training labels but provides little information about representation geometry. We use persistent homology to track loop structure across distance thresholds in neural activations. Experiments span image classification, text classification, and modular arithmetic. On a fixed CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 training probe, equally sized clean-label and corrupted-label subsets show no detectable persistence difference at epoch 10, whereas corrupted-label subsets have higher persistence at epoch 50. The contrast survives uniform-scale controls, even though predictions match the assigned noisy labels for only 7-11% of corrupted probe examples at that checkpoint. Normalisation preserves the crossover between clean and noisy training trajectories on CIFAR-10/ResNet-18, whereas CIFAR-100/ResNet-18 shows no crossover under any of the five evaluated constructions. In a separate noise-rate calibration comparison across five pipelines, mean activation norm achieves a higher mean in-sample R2 than raw persistence (0.936 versus 0.908). These findings show that noisy supervision leaves a measurable geometric signature even when agreement with corrupted labels is low. Comparing persistence under scale controls with label-fitting measurements offers a way to study how representations respond to label corruption beyond what training accuracy reveals.

title: Engineering nonrelativistic spin splitting in semiconductors by altermagnetic proximity
title_zh: 通过交变磁邻近工程设计半导体中的非相对论自旋分裂
summary: 交变磁体将消失的净磁化强度与动量相关的非相对论性自旋分裂相结合，为自旋电子学和量子器件提供了有吸引力的功能。然而，它们的实际应用受到同时具有所需的交磁对称性、半导体电子结构和弱自旋轨道耦合的材料的有限可用性的限制。在这里，我们表明，这些要求可以通过邻近工程在组成材料之间分开。我们开发了一种用于与带隙 d 波交变磁体耦合的传统半导体的分析理论，并证明虚拟隧道效应将交变磁体自旋分裂转移到半导体。至关重要的是，引起的非相对论性和相对论性自旋分裂表现出对能带排列的不同性质的依赖性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent, nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering functionalities attractive for spintronics and quantum devices. Their practical use, however, is constrained by the limited availability of materials that simultaneously possess the required altermagnetic symmetry, semiconducting electronic structure, and weak spin-orbit coupling. Here we show that these requirements can instead be separated between constituent materials through proximity engineering. We develop an analytical theory for a conventional semiconductor coupled to a gapped d-wave altermagnet and demonstrate that virtual tunneling transfers the altermagnetic spin splitting to the semiconductor. Crucially, the induced nonrelativistic and relativistic spin splittings exhibit qualitatively different dependences on band alignment. Virtual processes involving the valence and conduction bands of the altermagnet can reinforce the altermagnetic splitting while contributing with opposite signs to the interfacial Rashba coupling. Consequently, electrostatic tuning can access a regime in which the Rashba splitting vanishes while a sizable d-wave spin splitting persists. Exact diagonalization of the full heterostructure model confirms the analytical theory and establishes the robustness of this mechanism beyond the perturbative regime. Our results identify altermagnetic proximity as a route for engineering nonrelativistic spin-split electronic states in established semiconductor platforms, providing a general strategy for disentangling magnetic and relativistic spin interactions in quantum heterostructures.

title: Termination-dependent surface Fermiology in the intercalated altermagnet CoNb₄Se₈
title_zh: 插层交流磁体 CoNb₄Se₈ 中终止相关的表面费米学
summary: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交变磁体最近仍因其具有对称性强制自旋分裂能带而受到关注。角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）可以直接了解它们的电子结构。然而，该技术固有的表面敏感性使观察到的特征的识别变得复杂：表面态可能被误解为体带的自旋分裂对应物。这个问题对于层状插层系统尤其重要，其中具有不同终端的微米大小的域通常共存于劈裂表面上。我们讨论 CoNb₄Se₈ 的这种情况，CoNb₄Se₈ 是最早建立的层状交流磁体之一。
abstract: arXiv:2610.23375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets have recently gained attention for hosting symmetry-enforced spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. Angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES) offers direct access to their electronic structure. However, the intrinsic surface sensitivity of this technique complicates the identification of the observed features: Surface states can be misinterpreted as the spin-split counterpart of bulk bands. This issue becomes particularly relevant for layered intercalated systems, where micrometer-sized domains with distinct terminations often coexist on a cleaved surface. We discuss this scenario for CoNb₄Se₈, one of the first established layered altermagnets. Supported by density functional theory calculations, we employ micro-ARPES to probe individual domains and reveal two contrasting surface terminations. We identify Co- and Se-terminated domains with characteristic surface states arising from bulk-surface connectivity of the material. Our work shows that termination-dependent surface contributions are essential for the reliable spectroscopic identification of altermagnetism and for assessing its presence across the family of layered materials.
